The **Cryolator** is a heavy gun in *Fallout 76*.

The weapon fires a cryogenic beam that fades away at mid-range. It drains 5 Action Points and has a Cryo Slow effect that slows/freezes a target, based on the number of continuous hits applied to it:

| CryoSlowEffect (0018C354) | | | | 
| Stage | Stage Name | Continuous hits | Effect | 
| 1 | Chilled | 10 | -30% movement speed | 
| 2 | Frosted | 15 | -60% movement speed | 
| 3 | Frozen | 20 | -85% movement speed | 

More durable enemies will require a longer exposure, and some cannot be frozen at all. The Cryolator utilizes large amounts of ammunition quickly, which can be partially negated by using the Crystallizing Barrel mod.
